# Billy Andrews & Jane Andrews

## Shared scenes

> [Diana](../character/diana.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne.md) dress for a concert performance at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) offers her usual blunt observations before [Anne](../character/anne.md) leaves with [Diana](../character/diana.md), Jane, and [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md). Upon arriving at the grand hotel, [Anne](../character/anne.md) experiences intense stage fright while waiting among sophisticated performers and audience members. However, after spotting [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the crowd, her pride kicks in, allowing her to deliver a brilliant recitation that wins over the audience and earns her high praise.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) performs an encore for the audience and receives praise from several guests, including the professional elocutionist Mrs. [Evans](../character/evans.md). Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Diana](../character/diana.md), and Jane enjoy supper before [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) drives them home. On the ride back, the girls discuss the wealthy hotel guests, and [Anne](../character/anne.md) reflects on her contentment with her own life and loved ones.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) attend a farewell party thrown by the A.V.I.S., where they receive gifts before [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks home with [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md) to spite [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). The next evening, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visits [Anne](../character/anne.md) and takes her on a walk through the woods to find a wild apple tree, restoring her spirits ahead of her departure for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).
>
> — v3 · Chapter II Garlands of Autumn

> During an overnight stay, [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) proposes to [Anne](../character/anne.md) on behalf of her shy brother, [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) declines the offer, and Jane accepts the refusal coolly while noting that [Billy](../character/billy-andrews.md) will likely marry [Nettie Blewett](../character/nettie-blewett.md) instead. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne.md) reflects with a mixture of amusement and disappointment at how unromantic her very first marriage proposal turned out to be.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VIII Anne’s First Proposal
